title: Profile Outcome Pilot v1 — frozen task set
description: The tasks a pilot run executes, frozen before any session runs and before the randomisation seed exists. This file is a schema; the task set it describes has not been written.

pilot.description: Ties the task set to one protocol version. A changed protocol is a new pilot directory, not an edit to this one.

commit.description: Full SHA. The consumer package must be at this commit for every session; a change aborts the pilot.

base_commit.description: The MICA commit every worktree is created from.

frozen_at_utc.description: When this task set was frozen. Must precede the allocation's seed generation.

tasks.description: Exactly six. A different count is a different pilot.

prompt.description: The exact text both conditions receive. Identical across conditions; the condition changes what memory reaches the session, never what it is asked to do.

prompt_sha256.description: Digest of `prompt`, so a later edit is visible rather than silent.

profile.description: The profile condition B invokes. Declared here, not chosen during the run.

acceptance_command.description: Exits 0 or non-zero and decides the primary outcome. Written before the task runs, identical across conditions, never edited after a session has run against it.

allowed_change_paths.description: Paths the task may modify. A file touched outside these counts as an unnecessary change; a change outside them that acceptance requires means the task was specified wrong and the pair is excluded.

context_sensitivity_reason.description: One line on why which memory the session receives could plausibly matter here. A task no context could help tests nothing.
